newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Great Eagle's Tai Shan IPO seen priced end Feb.
newsitem.headline: Great Eagle's Tai Shan IPO seen priced end Feb.

text.p: Shares in the Great Eagle Holdings Ltd spin-off Tai Shan Properties Ltd are expected to be priced in late February and offered to the public in Hong Kong in early March, the lead underwriter said Monday.
Mark Crosby, director of Peregrine Capital Ltd, said an international road show will begin on February 17.
"An initial public offering (IPO) price for Tai Shan will be set at the end of the international road show...roughly at the end of February," he said.
"The Hong Kong public offering will take place in the following week in early March," Crosby said. "A precise date has not yet been fixed."
Peregrine is the lead underwriter and global coordinator of the initial public share offering of Tai Shan Properties Ltd.
Great Eagle said earlier on Monday that that it would spin off its Tai Shan unit to raise between HK$2.31 billion and HK$2.50 billion.
It said it would offer shares in Tai Shan in a Hong Kong public offering and also to international professional and institutional investors.
The composition of the underwriting sydnicate will be announced at the beginning of the road show, Crosby said.
